title: Macquarie Lighthouse
geometryBasis: Exact named building polygon, original coastal grade, and the State Library's explicit public-domain James Barnet elevation, plan and section, used after reviewing the published Qualla gallery.
sectionBasis: Square masonry plinth rises to a round tower and projecting gallery. The late Victorian cast iron lantern has diamond-patterned glazing and a domed cap above. The two low attached rooms have leaded domes.
limitations: The nearby keepers’ cottages, original Greenway tower site, and compound walls are outside the connected Barnet building. Small optic, vents, hardware and minor paint details are simplified.
